_source: Five Parsecs: Tactics p.155 (Hulkers profiles and Special Rules). Units are composed from data/tactics/army_builder.json (pp.133-139); weapons come from data/tactics/tactics_weapons_master.json (p.181)
_book_notes: p.155 gives Hulkers no civilian profile; 'Standard' is the military profile

species.description: Massive, powerful beings. Hulkers are determined fighters whose raw strength compensates for their impulsive nature.

traits.name: Determined
traits.description: Hulkers add +1 to all Morale tests.

traits.name: Powerful Swings
traits.description: Hulkers may use their fists instead of a weapon, making two close assault attacks per round and may use any weapon carried with either attack, hitting for damage +0, as if wielding a Melee weapon. Hulkers using a Melee weapon or Pistol may attack once with their main weapon and once with their fists.

traits.name: Short Tempered
traits.description: A Hulker failing a test for a technical or engineering task cannot attempt the task again.
